text: 本文开展系统综述；截至2026年8月29日检索PubMed，检索式为 hydrogel[Title/Abstract] AND implant[Title/Abstract]；纳入与排除标准预先确定。与此同时，临床队列的病例记录先去除重复记录——两名审阅者随后独立筛选这些记录；病例流程图列出检出、筛选和排除数量。
gold_reason: 分号和破折号连接了两个科学主体。去重、审阅和流程数量都属于临床病例记录，不是书目记录；文献选择的三项结构仍缺失。

text: We conducted a systematic review. Scopus was searched through 29 August 2026 with TITLE-ABS-KEY((hydrogel OR scaffold) AND implantation). Reports were included when they tested host response. The polymer candidate library—not the search export—underwent duplicate-record removal; two reviewers screened every record in that library, and its flow diagram lists records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: 破折号明确排除了search export，后续record均属于聚合物候选库；不能把材料候选处理升级为文献去重、筛选或流程核算。

text:
We conducted a systematic review. PubMed was searched through 29 August 2026 using implant[Title/Abstract]. Reports were included when they measured fibrosis.

The Results describe a hospital registry. Its entries are longitudinal electronic medical records rather than bibliographic citations.

They were deduplicated, two reviewers screened the records independently, and a flow chart reports records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: They跨两句回指hospital registry entries，且中间句明确它们是电子病历而非题录；三项操作不属于综述文献选择。

text:
We conducted a systematic review. MEDLINE was searched through 29 August 2026 using hydrogel*.ti,ab. Reports were included when they contained prospective implantation experiments.

The bibliographic search exports were merged. Their database provenance was retained in a separate column.

They were deduplicated, two reviewers independently screened all titles, abstracts, and full texts, and a PRISMA flow diagram reports records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: 跨两句的They仍有明确书目检索导出先行词；去重、题名摘要全文筛选和PRISMA流程都属于文献记录，是R5-03的正对照。

text: The present article is a narrative review using purposive examples and does not claim comprehensive coverage. Table 2 is titled This Systematic Review Reframes Implant Durability; the title reproduces the heading of a cited evidence table rather than declaring this article's genre.
gold_reason: 未加引号的表题含This Systematic Review，但句法明确说明它是被引用证据表的标题；本文先前的narrative自指仍应控制。

text: 本综述为叙述性综述，以代表性案例说明模型选择，未声称穷尽全部研究。表1引用某学会发布的指南，指南名称为“本系统综述报告要点”；该名称不描述本文文体。
gold_reason: 引号内是外部指南名，且后句明确否认其为本文文体；不得把中文指南标题中的本系统综述当作自指。

text: 本研究原拟开展系统综述；注册方案随后撤回，系统检索与记录筛选均未实施。最终成稿是一篇现实主义综述，围绕机制如何在不同情境中起作用展开。
gold_reason: 系统综述只是已撤回且未实施的历史计划；最终现实主义综述属于当前未支持类型，保守输出应为unspecified而非systematic。

text: The registered protocol originally designated a scoping review, but that design was superseded before any search was run. The final manuscript is a living review whose evidence set will be updated prospectively.
gold_reason: scoping只属于被取代且从未执行的方案；living review是当前类型本体之外的最终文体，不能回退到历史标签。

text: This article is an evidence mapping review. BIOSIS was searched through 28 August 2026 using TS=(hydrogel AND fibrosis). Eligibility criteria were prespecified; bibliographic records were deduplicated; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a record flow diagram enumerates records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: Evidence mapping review未在strict类型本体中；方法信号可以提取，但0退出码只表示门禁未适用，不能解释为该mapping review通过。

text: This is a realist review. Embase was searched through 2026 to identify mechanism-context-outcome explanations, but no executable string, eligibility record, deduplication account, screening process, or flow accounting is reported.
gold_reason: Realist review不应静默转成narrative或systematic；当前strict对其不适用，因此退出0是外部边界而非方法完整性判断。

text: We conducted a systematic review. MEDLINE was searched through 28 August 2026. Eligibility criteria were prespecified; bibliographic records were deduplicated; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a PRISMA flow chart accounts for records identified, screened, and excluded. Separately, the materials database was queried using MH "shape memory", where MH is the material-history field for each hydrogel batch.
gold_reason: MH字符串位于材料批次数据库，并在同句定义为material-history字段；它不是MEDLINE/Ovid检索式，系统综述仍缺查询记录。

text: We conducted a systematic review. PubMed was searched through 28 August 2026. Eligibility criteria were prespecified; bibliographic records were deduplicated; two reviewers independently screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; the PRISMA flow diagram reports records identified, screened, and excluded. The patient database was then queried with TITLE-ABS-KEY, a composite clinical variable formed from title, abscess status, and kidney injury.
gold_reason: TITLE-ABS-KEY在此被明确界定为患者数据库的复合临床变量，不是Scopus字段式；字段同名不能满足PubMed查询披露。

text: 本文开展系统综述，截至2026年8月28日检索SinoMed。预先规定纳入与排除标准，完成文献去重，由两名审阅者独立进行题名、摘要和全文筛选，PRISMA流程图列出检出、筛选与排除数量。随稿提交的补充方法S6现已收录各数据库逐字检索式及实际运行日期。
gold_reason: 随稿提交、现已收录均指向当前存在的补充方法，其中明确包含各库逐字检索式和运行日期。

text: 本文开展系统综述，截至2026年8月28日检索万方。预先规定纳入与排除标准，完成文献去重，由两名审阅者独立筛选题名、摘要和全文，PRISMA流程图列出检出、筛选与排除数量。补充表S7尚在整理，定稿后才会上传各数据库检索式与运行日期；当前文件未附该表。
gold_reason: 尚在整理、定稿后才会上传且当前未附，三重线索均表示未来附件；不能作为当前检索证据。

text: 本文开展系统综述，截至2026年8月28日检索中国知网。预先规定纳入与排除标准，完成文献去重，由两名审阅者独立筛选题名、摘要和全文，PRISMA流程图列出检出、筛选与排除数量。正文虽引用补充方法S8，但本次投稿包中并无该文件，逐库检索式也没有归档。
gold_reason: 正文引用不能证明附件存在；投稿包明确没有文件且检索式未归档，应归入兼容三态中的planned_or_placeholder而非claimed_present。

text: This narrative review searched PubMed through 28 August 2026. We selected representative prospective studies rather than an exhaustive census. Publisher platforms were visited. Access restrictions were recorded. They supplied article PDFs. DOI landing pages were also opened. The authors logged corrections. They confirmed publication metadata.
gold_reason: 两个They前均出现新的复数先行词（restrictions、authors），因此角色指代不够明确；应提示人工说明，而不是把邻近PDF或metadata词自动绑定到来源。

text: This narrative review searched Web of Science through 28 August 2026. Studies were selected to compare external validation, and the account is not comprehensive. Publisher platforms were visited. Access to each platform was logged. Those platforms supplied only article PDFs. DOI landing pages were consulted. Each landing page received a provenance identifier. Those pages were used only to confirm corrections, dates, and author metadata.
gold_reason: 虽然角色说明隔了一个记录访问/来源标识的句子，但Those platforms/pages重复了明确名词先行词；全文获取与元数据核验角色均无歧义，是R5-16的正对照。

text: 本叙述性综述检索PubMed至2026年8月28日，优先选择完成外部验证的研究，案例不作穷尽性统计。我们访问了出版社平台。访问日期另行记录。前述平台只承担全文下载。随后打开DOI落地页。每个页面均记录来源编号。上述页面仅用于核对作者、年份和撤稿状态。
gold_reason: 前述平台和上述页面在自然中文中明确回指各自来源，隔句的访问记录不改变全文下载与元数据/撤稿核验角色。

text: This narrative review searched Scopus through 28 August 2026 and selected illustrative experiments rather than an exhaustive census. Publisher platforms—not bibliographic indexes—served only to download full texts; DOI landing pages—not discovery sources—served only to verify authors, corrections, and publication status.
gold_reason: 同句用破折号排除了发现角色，并直接说明全文下载和发表状态核验；该明确负向限定不应触发角色缺失。

text: 本结构化叙述性综述检索Scopus至2026年8月28日，选择具有不同验证设计的研究作为案例，不声称全面覆盖。检索概念按研究问题分为五组——水凝胶；支架；纳米颗粒；组织修复；机器学习。这些词只用于说明概念范围，并不是可直接运行的数据库检索式。
gold_reason: 破折号后的五组分号概念是库存而非数据库语法，且正文已明确其不可运行；透明叙述范围成立，但仍应把长清单作为query-like inventory提示精简。
